stmt:3e7b02c9d514:huybrechts-fm.prop-1.3.title: A fully faithful exact functor with a left and right adjoint
stmt:3e7b02c9d514:huybrechts-fm.prop-1.3.informal: Informal statement of the criterion for a Fourier-Mukai kernel to induce an equivalence.
stmt:3e7b02c9d514:huybrechts-fm.prop-1.3.quote: Let F: D -> D' be a fully faithful exact functor between triangulated categories admitting a left and a right adjoint.
stmt:3e7b02c9d514:huybrechts-fm.prop-1.3.note: A textbook source carries NO version axis: there is no v1/v2 to pin, so `version` is null and the schema's arxiv-only version requirement must not reach it. arXMCP ships two textbook notebooks, so a registry that cannot express one is broken on arrival rather than merely incomplete.
